baslik: Amukanlı Nabû-mukin-zeri Babil tahtını ele geçirdi
metin: The second year: Nabû-nadin-zeri was killed in a rebellion. For two years Nabû-nadin-zeri ruled Babylon. Nabû-šuma-ukin, a district officer and leader of the rebellion, ascended the throne. For one month and two days, Nabû-šuma-ukin ruled Babylon. Nabû-mukin-zeri, the Amukanite, removed him from the throne and seized the throne for himself.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/ | ABC 1 i.14-18 | 'Nabû-mukin-zeri, the Amukanite, removed him from the throne and seized the throne for himself'

baslik: III. Tiglat-pileser Babil'i aldı ve kral oldu
metin: The third year of Nabû-mukin-zeri: Tiglath-pileser, having come down to Akkad, ravaged Bit-Amukanu and captured Nabû-mukin-zeri. For three years Nabû-mukin-zeri ruled Babylon. Tiglath-pileser ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/ | ABC 1 i.19-23 | 'ravaged Bit-Amukanu and captured Nabû-mukin-zeri ... Tiglath-pileser ascended the throne in Babylon' ; eponim [729/728]: 'the king took the hand of Bêl'

metin: On the twelfth day of the month Tebêtu, Sargon ascended the throne in Assyria. In the month Nisannu, Marduk-apla-iddina ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/ | ABC 1 i.31-32 | 'In the month Nisannu, Marduk-apla-iddina ascended the throne in Babylon'

baslik: II. Sargon Babil'i aldı; Marduk-apla-iddina Elam'a kaçtı
metin: The twelfth year of Marduk-apla-iddina: Sargon went down to Akkad and did battle against Marduk-apla-iddina. Marduk-apla-iddina retreated before him and fled to Elam. For twelve years Marduk-apla-iddina ruled Babylon. Sargon ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.1-5 | 'fled to Elam ... Sargon ascended the throne in Babylon' ; eponim [710/709]: 'campaign against Bit-zeri ... the king stayed in Kiš'

metin: During the eponomy of Šamaš-upahhir, the governor of Habruri, Kummuhu was captured; a governor was appointed.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/articles/concept/limmu/limmu-list-858-699-bce/ | Eponim kroniği, yıl [708/707] | 'Kummuhu was captured; a governor was appointed'

metin: During the eponomy of Ša-Aššur-dubbu, the governor of Tušhan, the king returned from Babylon; the chief vizier, the nobles, the booty of Dur-Yakin was carried off; [...] Dur-Yakin was destroyed
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/articles/concept/limmu/limmu-list-858-699-bce/ | Eponim kroniği, yıl [707/706] | 'Dur-Yakin was destroyed'
harita_degisimi: AKIN (yıkım/sefer — kalıcı kontrol değişimi KANITLANMADI; hedefe SAYILMAZ)

baslik: Sanherib Kiš'te Marduk-apla-iddina'yı yendi; Bel-ibni Babil tahtına
metin: The second year of Sennacherib, he went down to Akkad. Before Kiš, he joined battle with Marduk-apla-iddina. Before him, Marduk-apla-iddina retreated and fled to Guzummanu. In Babylon, Sennacherib entered the palace of Marduk-apla-iddina and the royal treasury [...] he plundered ... Larak and Sarrabanu he took. When he withdrew, Sennacherib put Bêl-ibni on the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.12-23 | 'Sennacherib put Bêl-ibni on the throne in Babylon'

baslik: Sanherib Bel-ibni'yi indirdi; Aššur-nadin-šumi Babil kralı
metin: The third year of Bêl-ibni: Sennacherib, to Akkad he went down and plundered Akkad. He led away to Assyria Bêl-ibni and his officers. For three years Bêl-ibni ruled Babylon. Sennacherib, Aššur-nadin-šumi, his son, he put on the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.26-31 | 'Aššur-nadin-šumi, his son, he put on the throne in Babylon' ; eponim [700/699] Aššur-nadin-šumi anılır

baslik: Elam Sippar'a girdi; Aššur-nadin-šumi esir; Nergal-ušezib tahta
metin: Afterwards, Hallušu-Inšušinak, king of Elam, marched to Akkad and entered Sippar at the end of the month Tašrîtu. He slaughtered its inhabitants. Šamaš did not go out of Ebabbar. Aššur-nadin-šumni was taken prisoner and transported to Elam. For six years, Aššur-nadin-šumni ruled Babylon. The king of Elam put Nergal-ušezib in Babylon on the throne. He effected an Assyrian retreat.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.36-45 (6. yıl Aššur-nadin-šumi = 694/693) | 'The king of Elam put Nergal-ušezib in Babylon on the throne'

metin: The first year of Nergal-ušezib: On the sixteenth day of the month Du'ûzu Nergal-ušezib captured Nippur, plundered and sacked it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.46-47 | 'Nergal-ušezib captured Nippur, plundered and sacked it' (polity: Elam'ın Babil'e koyduğu kral; dataset id'si nippur için hedef)

metin: Nergal-ušezib in the district of Nippur on the seventh day of the month Tašrîtu did battle against the army of Assyria. He was taken prisoner in the battlefield and transported to Assyria. For one year - precisely: six months - Nergal-ušezib ruled Babylon. ... Mušezib-Marduk ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.iii/ | ABC 1 iii.3-12 | 'He was taken prisoner in the battlefield and transported to Assyria' (gün -01-02 sadece sıralama için; kesinlik yıl)

metin: The fourth year of Mušezib-Marduk: ... On the first day of the month Kislîmu the city of Babylon was captured. Mušezib-Marduk was taken prisoner and transported to Assyria. For four years, Mušezib-Marduk ruled Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.iii/ | ABC 1 iii.19-24 | 'On the first day of the month Kislîmu the city of Babylon was captured'

baslik: Deniz Ülkesi: isyancı vali kaçtı; Na'id-Marduk vali atandı
metin: [The first year of the reign of Esarhaddon, Nabû-zer-kitti-lišir, governor of the Sealand, having come upstream, set up camp before Ur but did not take the city. He fled before the officers of Assyria and reached Elam. In Elam] the king of Elam [captured and executed him. Es]arhaddon named his brother Na'id-Marduk governor of the Sealand.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-14-esarhaddon-chronicle/ | ABC 14, 1-5 (ayrıca ABC 1 iii.39-42) | 'Esarhaddon named his brother Na'id-Marduk governor of the Sealand'

metin: The second year: the major-domo conscripted troops in Akkad. In that same year Arza was captured and sacked. The people were ransomed, the king and his son were taken prisoner.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-14-esarhaddon-chronicle/ | ABC 14, 9-11 | 'Arza was captured and sacked ... the king and his son were taken prisoner'
atif_dilim: K4 AKDENIZ / K2 MISIR (Mısır Çayı sınırı — iki aday)

metin: The fourth year: Sidon was captured and sacked.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1-2/ | ABC 1 iv.3 (ABC 14, 15) | 'Sidon was captured and sacked'

metin: The fifth year: On the second day of the month Tašrîtu the army of Assyria captured Baza.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1-2/ | ABC 1 iv.5-6 | 'the army of Assyria captured Baza'

metin: The eighth year: On the sixth day of the month Addaru the king's wife died. On the eighteenth day of the month Addaru the army of Assyria captured Šubria and sacked it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-14-esarhaddon-chronicle/ | ABC 14, 26-28 (ABC 1 iv.19-21 ayı Tebêtu verir) | 'the army of Assyria captured Šubria and sacked it' ; 8. yıl = 673/672, Addaru/Tebêtu → 672 başı

metin: The tenth year: In the month Nisannu the army of Assyria marched to Egypt ... On the third, sixteenth and eighteenth days of the month Du'uzu - three times - there was a massacre in Egypt. It was sacked and its gods were abducted. On the twenty-second day Memphis, the royal city, was captured and abandoned by its king. The king's son and brother were taken prisoner.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1-2/ | ABC 1 iv.23-28 | 'On the twenty-second day Memphis, the royal city, was captured'

metin: The accession year of Šamaš-šuma-ukin: ... In that same year Kirbitu was taken and its king captured.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1-2/ | ABC 1 iv.34-37 (ABC 14, 41) | 'Kirbitu was taken and its king captured'

metin: The seventeenth year: On the ninth day of the intercalary month Ulûlu, Šamaš-šuma-ukin mustered an army, marched to Cuthah and took the city. He defeated the army of Assyria and the Cutheans. He captured the statue of Nergal and took it to Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-15-samas-suma-ukin-chronicle/ | ABC 15, 7-10 | 'marched to Cuthah and took the city' (polity: Šamaš-šuma-ukin'in Babil'i; yeni-babil id'si 626 öncesi ise 'Babil (Šamaš-šuma-ukin)' olarak yazılmalı)

metin: The third year: On the eight day of the month [...] Der rebelled against Assyria.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-2-early-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 2, 29 | 'Der rebelled against Assyria'

baslik: Asur Der'i geri aldı; Nippur'a garnizon
metin: Afterward the king of Assyria went down to Akkad with his troops and took possession of Der; he took out its treasures and had them sent to Nippur. He pursued Itti-ili, ravaged Uruk?, and set up a garrison at Nippur.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-2-early-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 2, 30-32 | 'took possession of Der ... set up a garrison at Nippur'

baslik: Suhu ve Hindanu Nabopolassar'a haraç verdi (bağlılık değişimi)
metin: The tenth year of Nabopolassar: In the month Ajaru, Nabopolassar mustered the army of Akkad and marched along the bank of the Euphrates. The Suheans and Hindaneans did not do battle against him but placed their tribute before him.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y10 (sat. 1-2) | 'The Suheans and Hindaneans did not do battle against him but placed their tribute before him'

metin: On the twelfth of the month Âbu he did battle against the army of Assyria and the army of Assyria retreated before him. He inflicted a major defeat upon Assyria and plundered them extensively. He captured the Manneans, who had come to the Assyrians' aid, and the Assyrian officers. On the same day he captured Gablini.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y10 | 'On the same day he captured Gablini'

baslik: Medler Tarbisu'yu aldı ve Assur'u yıktı
metin: The twelfth year: In the month Âbu the Medes, after they had matched against Nineveh [lacuna], hastened and they captured Tarbisu, a city in the district of Nineveh. They went along the Tigris and encamped against Aššur. They did battle against the city and destroyed it. ... The city was taken.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y12 | 'They did battle against the city and destroyed it' (kaybeden: yeni-asur; fail: Medler)

baslik: Suhu isyanı bastırıldı: Rahilu ve Anat alındı
metin: The thirteenth year: In the month Ajaru the Suheans rebelled against the king of Akkad and became belligerent. The king of Akkad mustered his army and marched to Suhu. On the fourth day of the month Simanu he did battle against Rahi-ilu, a city which is on an island in the middle of the Euphrates and at that time he captured the city. ... he encamped against Anati ... He did battle against the city and captured it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y13 | 'he captured the city ... He did battle against the city and captured it' (fail: yeni-babil)

metin: In the month Arahsamna the king of Akkad took the lead of his army personally and marched against Ruggulitu. He did battle against the city and on the twenty-eighth day of the month Arahsamnu he captured it. He did not leave a single man alive.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y15 | 'on the twenty-eighth day of the month Arahsamnu he captured it'

baslik: Harran Babilliler ve Medler tarafından alındı
metin: In the month Arahsamna the Medes, who had come to the help of the king of Akkad, put their armies together and marched to Harran against Aššur-uballit, who had ascended the throne in Assyria. Fear of the enemy overcame Aššur-uballit and the army of Egypt that had come to help him, and they abandoned the city, and crossed the Euphrates. The king of Akkad reached Harran, fought a battle, and captured the city.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y16 | 'The king of Akkad reached Harran, fought a battle, and captured the city'

metin: In the month Tašrîtu the king of Akkad mustered his army and marched to Kimuhu, which is on the bank of the Euphrates. He crossed the river, did battle against the city, and in the month Kislîmu he captured the city. He sacked it and stationed a garrison of his in it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-4-late-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 4, 12-15 (19. yıl = 607/606) | 'in the month Kislîmu he captured the city ... stationed a garrison'

metin: The twentieth year: The army of Egypt marched against the garrison of Kimuhu which the king of Akkad had stationed inside. For four months, they laid siege to the city, captured it, and defeated the garrison of the king of Akkad.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-4-late-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 4, 16-18 | 'they laid siege to the city, captured it, and defeated the garrison' (kaybeden: yeni-babil; fail: Mısır)

metin: In the twenty-first year ... Nebuchadnezzar ... marched to Karchemiš which is on the bank of the Euphrates, and crossed the river to go against the Egyptian army which lay in Karchemiš. ... the Babylonian troops overtook and defeated them so that not a single man escaped to his own country. At that time Nebuchadnezzar conquered the whole area of Hamath.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-5-jerusalem-chronicle/ | ABC 5 obv.1-8 | 'At that time Nebuchadnezzar conquered the whole area of Hamath'

metin: He marched to the city of Aškelon and captured it in the month of Kislîmu. He captured its king and plundered it and carried off spoil from it. He turned the city into a mound and heaps of ruins
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-5-jerusalem-chronicle/ | ABC 5 obv.18-20 (1. yıl Nebukadnezar = 604/603) | 'He marched to the city of Aškelon and captured it in the month of Kislîmu'

baslik: Kudüs alındı; Babil'in seçtiği kral atandı
metin: In the seventh year, the month of Kislîmu, the king of Akkad mustered his troops, marched to the Hatti-land, and besieged the city of Judah and on the second day of the month of Addaru he seized the city and captured the king. He appointed there a king of his own choice, received its heavy tribute and sent to Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-5-jerusalem-chronicle/ | ABC 5 rev.11'-13' | 'on the second day of the month of Addaru he seized the city and captured the king' (Livius notu: February/March 597; Jülyen gün verilmediği için kesinlik=yil)
atif_dilim: K4 AKDENIZ / K7 ORTACAG (Kudüs — iki aday)

metin: The third year: ... Neriglissar mustered his army and marched to Hume to oppose him. ... He captured him, seized Ura, and sacked it. ... he captured Kirši, the mighty city, his royal metropolis. He burnt its wall, its palace, and its people. Pitusu, a land in the midst of the ocean, and six thousand combat troops who were stationed in it he captured by means of boats.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-6-neriglissar-chronicle/ | ABC 6, 1-23 (3. yıl = 557/556) | 'seized Ura, and sacked it ... he captured Kirši'
